name: Transaction Repository API
shortSummary: Event-driven repository service designed as part of a monolith decomposition into clear service boundaries.
technicalDescription: Serves normalized transaction records for downstream consumers with stable contracts, strong operational visibility, and a focus on high-read access patterns.
architecture: Harmonization layer for domain-specific payload normalization
Persistence model optimized for high-read transaction access patterns
Encrypted event publication for trusted consumers
outcomes: Supported gradual migration from a legacy monolith into well-defined service boundaries.
Improved maintainability by isolating repository concerns from legacy components.
teamNote: Developed with a backend squad. My role focused on migration tasks, API behavior discussions, and production hardening alongside teammates.

name: Transaction Query Service
shortSummary: Read-oriented service focused on query performance and clean separation from write paths.
technicalDescription: Exposes query-oriented endpoints for transaction listing while preserving domain consistency, observability, and production-safe release practices.
architecture: Read-focused API endpoints over the transaction repository
Clear separation from write and ingestion concerns
Monitoring for latency and error rates
Support for controlled, production-safe release cycles
outcomes: Helped transition transaction listing responsibilities away from monolith paths.
Reduced operational friction through clearer service ownership boundaries.
teamNote: Built collaboratively inside the backend team. I contributed to query logic, integration behavior, and incident-oriented reliability work.

name: Upstream Integration Platform
shortSummary: Upstream banking integration service used by both external and internal consumers under strict operational constraints.
technicalDescription: Coordinates upstream data exchange with controlled deployment windows, capacity planning, and strong alignment with on-call and incident practices.
architecture: Upstream integration with controlled deployment windows
Capacity planning and operational dependency handling
Incident response alignment with established on-call practices
outcomes: Sustained stable flows for multiple internal and external consumers.
Improved release confidence through coordinated deployment routines.
teamNote: Operated by a cross-functional team. My contribution centered on operational readiness, deployment execution, and coordination across stakeholders.

name: DevOps Platform / Microservices Maintenance
shortSummary: Reliability and maintenance ownership for approximately ten production microservices.
technicalDescription: Day-to-day platform work spanning vulnerabilities, dependency updates, and incident-driven stabilization.
architecture: Security and vulnerability remediation with Checkmarx
Dependency upgrades for Spring Boot and related components
Metrics-driven maintenance via Grafana and Prometheus
outcomes: Maintained service stability during frequent operational changes.
Improved response readiness during 24x7 on-call rotation periods.
teamNote: This is shared platform work. I participate in planning and execution with engineers, PO, and operations; ownership is collective, not individual.
